bullets.title: American-Made Wrist Bar | ATG Equipment
bullets.note: I’m using this to build wrist strength and also rehab my tennis elbow. [Here’s a quick demonstration](https://youtu.be/PzEXjWeo35Y?si=eL8wyK6liG11q_Ds&t=235) of how to use the bar with small weight plates, and I’m mostly doing slow eccentrics followed by yielding isometrics as described by [Dr. Keith Baar](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BnFzjcPTSsc). Plates and clamps must be purchased separately, and I’m using micro-plates (search “Olympic fractional plates”) of ¼, ½, ¾, and 1 pound to progressively load between larger hops. Hat tip to [The Knees Over Toes Guy](https://www.youtube.com/c/thekneesovertoesguy), who is also the founder of ATG.

bullets.title: Who broke the sperm bank?
bullets.creator: Mark Ellwood
bullets.note: (_Financial Times_). From the article: “American sperm has become one of the country’s priciest resources. By weight, super-premium semen ($4,000 or more for a gram) now costs more than Beluga caviar (up to $3 a gram for roe), which represents a tenfold rise in price over the past decade.”

bullets.title: Efficacy of Adjunctive D-Cycloserine to Intermittent Theta-Burst Stimulation for Major Depressive Disorder
bullets.note: From the Key Points: “In this double-blind, placebo-controlled, randomized clinical trial that included 50 participants, those receiving intermittent theta-burst stimulation with adjunctive D-cycloserine (100 mg) had significantly greater improvements in depressive symptoms compared with stimulation with a placebo.”
